free_text: The patient is a 65-year-old male with an ISUP grade group 1 adenocarcinoma, cT1c staging, and a PSA of 11.0 ng/mL. MRI shows a PI-RADS 4 lesion in the mid left peripheral zone with restricted diffusion, and no extracapsular extension. The competing illness is not specified. Management assessment is active surveillance pending clinical review of individual treatment benefit and patient preferences.
